cards.title: MIC Distribution and PTA Input Requirements
cards.claim: For a conditional PTA at one MIC, require that MIC value and a matched PD target, exposure basis and simulation distribution. For PTA across a development-relevant MIC range, include values at the upper end and report organism/resistance strata as applicable to EMA antimicrobial guidance. For CFR, require a scenario-representative MIC frequency distribution and denominator; do not use an aggregated ECOFF reference as default local weights.
conditions: When preparing inputs for PTA simulations.
When evaluating the applicability of a PD target to a population.
required_inputs: Definition of wild-type vs. resistant subpopulations.
Source of MIC data (clinical isolates, ECVs).
limitations: PTA is not probability of clinical cure.
MIC distributions must be representative of the intended clinical use.
Abstract-only material supports only what appears in the abstract.
cards.downstream_use: Calculation of Probability of Target Attainment (PTA) and Cumulative Fraction of Response (CFR).

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
